$description: Atelier design tokens (DTCG), rebranded for TASAMA (tasama.com.sa). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit here only; never hand-edit src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx. Copied from the Tasama Ascend tokens and quietened for Tasama HR on 6 Oct 2026 at the client's request (backgrounds quiet: near-white light, soft neutral charcoal dark). Palette read from the computed styles of tasama.com.sa: #10069F wordmark ultramarine, #07105F hero navy, #342BAD panel violet, #B59E5F bilingual-subline gold, #ADDC91 portrait nimbus green. REBRANDING CONTRACT: a client rebrand changes ONLY color.light, color.dark, the brand block, typography.fontFamily and the asset files in public/brand/. Everything else stays identical across every app. See docs/REBRANDING.md.

background.$description: Quiet near-white with the faintest cool cast. The client asked for backgrounds that are not saturated or distracting, so the brand blue lives on fills and ink, not on the page.

primary.$description: Tasama ultramarine — the wordmark ink, used verbatim; white on it clears AAA.

secondary.$description: The violet-blue Tasama uses for filled panels on tasama.com.sa.

accent.$description: Tasama gold #B59E5F deepened to clear 4.5:1 on the light background; hue preserved (~43°), so it stays the brand's second colour rather than a different one.

chart1.$description: Categorical series colour, slot 1 of a fixed five, assigned in this order and never cycled. Ascend's validated Tasama set, re-validated with the dataviz validate_palette.js against the white card on 6 Oct 2026. Blue and violet are deliberately not adjacent.

background.$description: Soft neutral charcoal with only a faint navy tint. Not near-black and not saturated blue, per the client's request for quiet backgrounds.

primary.$description: Tasama ultramarine lifted for the dark theme; #10069F is too dark to carry text or fills on charcoal.

accent.$description: Tasama gold lifted for the dark theme — the logo's own blue-and-gold pairing, inverted.

chart1.$description: Ascend's validated Tasama dark set, re-validated against the dark card #1C1F29.

sans.$description: Body, tables, figures: Inter for Latin (tabular numerals). Alexandria as the fallback carries every Arabic glyph, since Inter has no Arabic.

serif.$description: Atelier's --font-serif is the heading/display face. Alexandria is the typeface tasama.com.sa sets its whole site in — a geometric sans drawn for Arabic and Latin together, which matches the wordmark's construction. Covers Arabic as well.

mono.$description: Eyebrows, section labels, references, telemetry chips.

wordmark.$description: The product wordmark in the title bar, set in Tasama's own face.

brand.$description: The TASAMA brand layer: signature gradient, highlight, status hues, backdrop stops, wallpaper art and the hero dark island.

gradient.$description: Four stops of the signature accent gradient (--brand-grad), running ultramarine → violet → lifted ultramarine → gold: the wordmark's own blue-to-gold pairing, in the order the logo reads. stop3 matches color.dark.primary.

highlight.$description: TASAMA's highlight green — the colour on their own call-to-action pills. Used for interactive affordances and for the measures that are about the CLIENT rather than about performance. Never used on a status surface: RAG green means something else, and two greens on one screen is how a reader starts guessing.

wash.$description: The brand colour verbatim. A fill, not a text colour — 1.6:1 on white.

light.$description: Deepened to clear 4.5:1 on both white and the light background; hue preserved at 93°.

dark.$description: On the dark background the brand colour is legible as drawn — 12.4:1 — so it is used exactly as TASAMA draws it.

status.$description: Status is not brand. Green, amber and red stay recognisable even though none of them is a Tasama colour.

backdrop.$description: 160deg backdrop stops, shown while the wallpaper loads. Kept within a few points of the page background so nothing reads as a colour field.

backdropArtOpacity.$description: Opacity of the wallpaper layer per theme. Both artworks are quiet (greyscale spread under 20), so both run at full strength.

hero.$description: The .page-hero dark island in both themes: Tasama hero navy #07105F softened to #1B1F4A so it is not a near-black slab, carrying the Tasama bilingual gold #B59E5F verbatim as its accent (6:1 on the navy).
